## Summary

Describe the behavior, benchmark data, or documentation changed.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 repro/audit_release_compliance.py`
- [ ] `python3 repro/validate_release.py` when release artifacts or contracts changed
- [ ] No credentials, private endpoints, internal paths, proprietary assets, or personal data added
- [ ] Third-party code/data/service changes are described and notices updated
- [ ] Result changes are generated from documented inputs and are limited to intended data
- [ ] CLA requirements are satisfied
